title: QA run · release-18.4.0-w1-owed (11/11) · ff04ad81 · 2026-11-10 · 5 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 4 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
qa#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2Acf5wtyrf2yKWCThBj

Runner `session_012dn2Aej8bK94WiqAMApccX` (cloud, effort high), dispatched by `qa#2` (#32023) as round 1, slice R1: an early probe of the 18.4.0 release wave, on the maintainer's word 「开跑」. The runner staged the record; the seat posts it through the relay. The seat cross-checked the mechanisms of cards A, D, P-1, P-2 and P-3 against the subject's source.

This record covers the owed retest list `release-18.4.0-w1-owed` (`scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs`): 11 items whose QA-extracted fix cards closed after their last verdict.

**Result: 11/11 judged · 5 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 4 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.** No planned item. No security finding.

- The 4 FAIL items are 2 product defects (R-3, R-4) and 2 stale specs (R-1, R-2). Off-clause probes found 3 more product defects.
- All 12 fix cards named by the owed rows HOLD: #24784, #31488, #31490, #31491, #31492, #31493, #31494, #31495, #31496, #31497, #31498, and #27482 (against its ruled acceptance).

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `ff04ad811da54166a5d1114fade5a1a6ab99138c` (main, 2026-11-10), detached. `ui/` is the in-tree import at the same commit, and the Console was built from it.
- **Build:** one cold cloud container. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 19 s; `pnpm build --concurrency=2` 119/119 tasks in 10m26s; `pnpm console:build` a cache hit plus copy; `check-dev-prereqs` 107 artifacts.
- **Slices:** the main session plus three runner sub-agents (effort high) in the same container, in parallel. Each item had its own port and file DB under /tmp. Boots were `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p PORT -d file:/tmp/...` with `OS_PORT` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported, unless an item's fixture says otherwise.
  - main: access-security, cli, platform-core.seed-mode-matrix, studio-authoring.meta-save (ports 41441–41458)
  - s1: automation.screen-flow-roundtrip, platform-core.url-overlay-contract, studio-authoring.expression-editors (41410–41412)
  - s2: the two ux-conventions items (41420–41421)
  - s3: identity-auth.auth-method-matrix, integration-system.email-template-render (41430–41435, SMTP sink 41439 via plugin-email `startFakeSmtp`)
- **Seed and personas:** the stock showcase seed and seeded admin. Members were made by invite plus sign-up with `invitationId`, or by admin create-user on walled boots. Identity was proved server-side before each persona's cells.
- **Walled boots:** `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group` and `isolated`, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`, from the tree.
- **Older databases:**
  - v17: a `create-objectstack@17.7.0` blank scaffold booted once by its own 17.7.0 `os dev`.
  - 18.0 pre-release: the committed `cli-18-prerelease-db` restore.
- **Hygiene:** every port free at the end, `git status` clean, `.objectstack/installed-packages` empty. One apply report escaped into the tree and was moved out at once (cli item).
- **Rule 7:** a second, independent agent re-derived the P0 FAIL (access-security acceptance[4] and [6]) from the captured evidence alone. It agreed: FAIL, stale spec.
- **Spend:** runner session $31.07 (`get_session` usage.cost_usd, sub-agents included).

## Scope

Selector `release-18.4.0-w1-owed`: 11 ids, each resolved with `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs ID --json`. access-security was resolved with `--include-blocked`: its `blocked` marker (#9334) hides it, but its walled-boot fixture is provisionable on this tree, so it was run.

access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics r9 · automation.screen-flow-roundtrip r7 · cli.organization-ownership-ceremony r9 · identity-auth.auth-method-matrix r10 · integration-system.email-template-render r17 · platform-core.seed-mode-matrix r8 · platform-core.url-overlay-contract r5 · studio-authoring.expression-editors r9 · studio-authoring.meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows r3 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason r6 · ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names r4

- access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics: **FAIL**, acceptance[4] and [6], stale spec (R-1). #24784 HOLDS live on a walled group boot.
- automation.screen-flow-roundtrip: **PASS**. #31491 HOLDS.
- cli.organization-ownership-ceremony: **PASS**. #31488 HOLDS.
- identity-auth.auth-method-matrix: **PARTIAL**, acceptance[0]'s SSO and device variants are blocked(environment) (knownGaps[3]). #31492 HOLDS.
- integration-system.email-template-render: **PARTIAL**, acceptance[7]'s no-provider 501 sub-case is scored from the unit pin only. #31496 HOLDS.
- platform-core.seed-mode-matrix: **PASS**. #31497 HOLDS.
- platform-core.url-overlay-contract: **PASS**. #31498 HOLDS.
- studio-authoring.expression-editors: **FAIL**, acceptance[4] and negative[1], stale spec (R-2). #27482 HOLDS against its ruled acceptance.
- studio-authoring.meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows: **PASS**. #31490 HOLDS.
- ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason: **FAIL**, acceptance[0]–[2], product defect (R-3). #31493 and #31495 HOLD.
- ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names: **FAIL**, acceptance[0] and [1], product defect (R-4). #31494 HOLDS.

## Per-clause verdict tables

### access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics r9 (P0 api) · main · 41443 (group), 41444 (isolated)

**Fixture:** a walled boot of the stock showcase (RUNNER "A walled boot is a fixture of its own"). Both postures booted with no FATAL.

**Producer (2) of knownGaps[0]:**
1. The operator creates org A and org B (`POST /api/v1/auth/organization/create`, 200 each).
2. The operator seeds a `showcase_account` in B as the cross-tenant control.
3. With A active, the operator mints member M by `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user` (200, organizationId A, membershipCreated true).
4. M changes its password, signs in, sets A active, then `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/set-active {"organizationId": null}` (200).
5. `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` reads `activeOrganizationId` null.

Producer (1), a member-less user, has had no door since #25626, so its legs are blocked(fixture) per knownGaps[0].

| clause | verdict | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| acceptance[0] | pass | isolated: M reads showcase_account, showcase_project and showcase_task → 200, 0 rows each. group: 200 with 14, 5 and 10 rows, all organization_id A, none of B. The producer (1) leg is blocked(fixture). |
| acceptance[1] | pass | Both postures: M `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task` → 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` "… this session has no active organization — so this insert has no organization to place the record in. Join or select an active organization and retry." |
| acceptance[2] | pass | Admin-side SQLite count of NULL or empty organization_id: showcase_task 0 → 0, showcase_account 0 → 0. Task total 30 → 30. |
| acceptance[3] | pass | M (no active org): GET org B's showcase_account row → 404; PATCH → 403; `GET /api/v1/sharing/rules` → 403 (manage_sharing). Pin `sharing-rule-org-less-caller.dogfood.test.ts` green. |
| acceptance[4] | **fail** | M's raw `sys_audit_log` rows, both postures: login A, login A, **logout with tenant_id NULL** (sent while the session had no active org), login A. The operator reads it (200); M gets 403 (object permission). → R-1 |
| acceptance[5] | pass | get-session 200. M reads `sys_user` 200 and `meta/object/showcase_task` 200. Zero 5xx and zero "Unhandled error". |
| acceptance[6] | **fail** | Sharing refuses (403) and layer 0 and the write path scope or refuse, but the audit ledger accepts a NULL-attributed logout row for the same state. → R-1 (same root) |
| acceptance[7] | pass | Walled group, producer (2) with membership {A}: POST showcase_task → 403 (the acceptance[1] envelope, not 500 ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED), again on a second sign-in. NULL count 0 → 0. Control: with A active → 201, organization_id A. **#24784 HOLDS live.** |
| negatives[0]–[5] | held | No cross-tenant read or write; no NULL-stamped row; the acceptance[4] row is visible to the operator; no 5xx; the refusal names the missing org; the code is PERMISSION_DENIED. |

Pins: plugin-security `no-active-organization-write-refusal.test.ts` and `no-active-organization-insert-union-scope.test.ts` (29 passed); dogfood `no-active-organization-write-refusal.dogfood.test.ts` and `sharing-rule-org-less-caller.dogfood.test.ts` (22 passed).

### cli.organization-ownership-ceremony r9 (P0 cli) · main · 41450–41458

**v17 database:** a blank `create-objectstack@17.7.0` scaffold (`npm install --legacy-peer-deps`). Its own 17.7.0 `os dev --seed-admin` booted once over `file:/tmp/qa/v17/db/v17.db`. Copies c1–c4 and H were taken from it (sha256 3a84e5c9…). The ceremony legs ran as a production `os serve` with OS_AUTH_SECRET and OS_SECRET_KEY set; the 18.0 leg ran under `--dev`.

| clause | verdict | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| acceptance[0] | pass | 9 pin files green at ff04ad81 (cli apply-flags 7, organization-ownership-apply 117, occupancy.integration 5, dialect 19, apply-organization-ownership-gate.integration 5, comment-reactions.integration 7, host-supplement.integration 7, apply.generation-1 17; runtime organization-ownership-boot-guard 30). |
| acceptance[1] | pass | First `os serve` over c1 → exit 1, refusal. Bare plan → exit 0, `organization-ownership-plan`, ceremony "ADR-0131 D10", 150 table rows ("127 table(s) planned … 74 will receive NOT NULL"). Primary sha256 unchanged. `--apply` without `--plan-file` → exit 1 `apply_refused` / `plan-file-required` (text: "✗ Refused: --apply executes only a plan you reviewed."); checksum unchanged. |
| acceptance[2] | pass | `--apply --plan-file plan.json --backup-taken --out apply.json --json` → exit 0, complete, blocking 0, 13 steps done. sys_migration `adr-0131-organization-ownership` verified, `shapeGeneration` 1 equals `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_SHAPE_GENERATION`. |
| acceptance[3] | pass | `os serve` over migrated c1 → ready, health 200. Over unmigrated c2 → exit 1 "✗ This database carries no organization-ownership marker …" with "Run 'os migrate organization-ownership --out PLAN' …". 0 hits for "17.x release". The `--dev` 18.0 boot printed the `--dev` form of the command. |
| acceptance[4] | pass | Fresh c4: `comment-reactions --apply` without `--yes` → exit 1; with `--yes` twice → exit 0. Then `os migrate apply --allow-destructive --yes --json` → exit 1 `refused_organization_ownership_unmigrated` naming 9 tables, `"applied":[]`, sha256 unchanged. |
| acceptance[5] | pass | `cli-18-prerelease-db` restore (the committed dump), reset token re-dated. The census matched the manifest. `serve --dev` → exit 1 naming sys_flow_credential and sys_secret; plan → exit 0; apply → exit 0, complete, blocking 0 (sibling-moves moved 10, jobsRewritten 2, mirrorsDeleted 1, column-drops 2). Second boot ready. Identity mails moved to `sys_identity_email` (24 common columns equal except updated_at and attempt_count); invitation mails stay; 8 global audit rows moved to `sys_platform_setting_audit`; 2 identity-mail jobs re-pointed. Admin, member A and member B sign in with their 18.0 passwords (wrong password → 401). The reset token from the moved mail works. One showcase_task PATCH → exactly one `sys_http_delivery` row, ref_id `declared:showcase_task_changed`. The only unlisted count decrease is telemetry `sys_activity__r20261027` (66 rows), which is sys_activity's 14-day rotation, not the apply (A-3). |
| negative[0] | held | The plan run and every refusing arm left the checksum unchanged. |

**#31488 HOLDS.** `os start --no-ui --no-compile --home H` over a v17 copy → exit 1, and the printed commands carry `--database-url file:H/data/objectstack.db` and the auth secret. Run verbatim with OS_HOME and OS_DATABASE_URL unset, the plan writes and the apply completes; `os start --home H` then boots. A path with a space is quoted correctly.

Hygiene: the verbatim apply (no `--out`) wrote its report into `examples/app-showcase/`. It was moved out at once. Not a defect: the ceremony prints where it wrote.

## Repro rules (every FAIL)

**R-1 · access-security · acceptance[4], [6] · stale spec.**
1. Boot walled as above.
2. Create org A and set it active.
3. Create member M in A.
4. As M: change the password, sign in, `set-active {"organizationId": null}`, then sign out.
5. Read `sys_audit_log` in the telemetry sibling for M.

The logout row has tenant_id NULL. Mechanism: plugin-auth `auth-session-audit.ts` `logoutEventFor` takes the session's activeOrganizationId; plugin-audit `auth-event-audit.ts` writes `tenant_id: event.organizationId ?? null`.
